sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 扎伊尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，畅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Your party wants to go socialist medicine and socialist health care.
sentences.zh: 你们党想要推行社会主义医疗和社会主义医保。

sentences.en: And they're going to dominate you, Joe, you know that.
sentences.zh: 他们会压倒你的，乔，你知道这一点。

sentences.en: I am the Democratic Party right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就是民主党。

sentences.en: The platform of the Democratic Party is what I, in fact, approved of.
sentences.zh: 民主党的纲领实际上就是我所认可的。

sentences.en: What I approved of.
sentences.zh: 我所认可的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: We are facing too many crises.
sentences.zh: 我们正面临太多的危机。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: We have too much work to do.
sentences.zh: 我们有太多的工作要做。

sentences.en: In part two of our look at the policies of the presidential candidates.
sentences.zh: 在我们审视总统候选人政策的第二部分中。

sentences.en: This is our moment to imagine and to build a new American economy.
sentences.zh: 这是我们构想并建设一个新美国经济的时刻。

sentences.en: I'm going to invest $2 trillion in infrastructure and clean energy.
sentences.zh: 我将投资2万亿美元用于基础设施和清洁能源。

sentences.en: I'll be laser focused on working families.
sentences.zh: 我将全神贯注于工薪家庭。

sentences.en: High speed broadband in every American household.
sentences.zh: 让每个美国家庭都能用上高速宽带。

sentences.en: My plan will create 18.6 million jobs in the next four years.
sentences.zh: 我的计划将在未来四年内创造1860万个就业岗位。

sentences.en: My colleague, Alex Burns, on Joe Biden's plans for a crisis presidency.
sentences.zh: 我的同事亚历克斯·伯恩斯将介绍乔·拜登关于危机总统任期的计划。

sentences.en: I'm running as a proud Democrat, but I will govern as an American president.
sentences.zh: 我以一名自豪的民主党人身份参选，但我将以一位美国总统的身份执政。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月16日，星期五。

sentences.en: Alex, we have been talking about the campaign with you for at least a year, and I'm slightly embarrassed by my lack of knowledge of Joe Biden's specific policy plans,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我们和你讨论竞选活动至少有一年了，我对我不了解乔·拜登的具体政策计划感到有些尴尬，

sentences.en: which is what we want to talk with you about.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我们想和你谈论的内容。

sentences.en: You know, I think that you're not alone in, I don't know about the embarrassment, but certainly the sense of not having deep familiarity with the Biden policy agenda.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想你并不孤单，我不知道你是否真的感到尴尬，但肯定很多人对拜登的政策议程缺乏深入了解。

sentences.en: And I think there are good reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这其中有很好的理由。

sentences.en: You know, during the Democratic primary, Joe Biden rolled out policy plans, but he was not a policy intensive 10 point plan kind of speech maker the way, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在民主党初选期间，乔·拜登推出了政策计划，但他并不是那种会发表密集型“十点计划”演讲的人，不像，你知道，

sentences.en: when Elizabeth Warren or to some extent Pete Buttigieg was.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦或者在某种程度上皮特·布蒂吉格那样。

sentences.en: Folks, there are three basic reasons why I'm running for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 各位，我竞选美国总统有三个基本原因。

sentences.en: He was running on these broad themes.
sentences.zh: 他当时竞选的主题非常广泛。

sentences.en: The first is to restore the soul of the nation.
sentences.zh: 第一是恢复国家的灵魂。

sentences.en: And the second is to rebuild the backbone of this nation.
sentences.zh: 第二是重建这个国家的脊梁。

sentences.en: And the third is to unify this nation.
sentences.zh: 第三是统一这个国家。

sentences.en: We always do better when we act as one America.
sentences.zh: 当我们作为一个统一的美国行动时，我们总是做得更好。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was about restoring a kind of pre-Trump political culture to the United States.
sentences.zh: 这关乎恢复一种特朗普之前的美国政治文化。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Look, I believe that the president is literally an existential threat to America.
sentences.zh: 听着，我相信总统对美国来说简直是一个生存威胁。

sentences.en: He was campaigning on the idea that the biggest problem facing the country was President Trump and that the way you deal with that problem is you get rid of President Trump and you do that by nominating and electing Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 他竞选的核心理念是，国家面临的最大问题是特朗普总统，而解决这个问题的办法就是除掉特朗普总统，方法就是提名并选举乔·拜登。

sentences.en: And he had other ideas, things he would do next.
sentences.zh: 他当然还有其他想法，关于接下来要做的事情。

sentences.en: But the focus was beat Trump.
sentences.zh: 但重点是击败特朗普。

sentences.en: Four years of Donald Trump will be viewed as an aberration in American history.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的四年任期将被视为美国历史上的一个反常现象。

sentences.en: Eight years, eight years will fundamentally change who we are as a nation and how we're viewed around the world.
sentences.zh: 八年，八年将从根本上改变我们作为一个国家的本质，以及我们在世界眼中的形象。

sentences.en: But that really begins to change with the onset of the pandemic and with Biden's emergence as the presumptive Democratic nominee.
sentences.zh: 但这确实随着疫情的爆发和拜登作为民主党推定提名人的出现而开始改变。

sentences.en: And we start to hear more specifically from him about how he would approach the national emergency that we're in.
sentences.zh: 我们开始更具体地听到他将如何应对我们所处的国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: This disease could impact every nation and any person on the planet.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病可能会影响地球上的每个国家和每个人。

sentences.en: We need a plan about how we're going to aggressively manage here at home.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个关于我们如何在国内积极管理的计划。

sentences.en: And we start to hear in more extensive terms from him about how he would approach a number of the other most pressing issues facing the country as he sees them.
sentences.zh: 我们开始更广泛地听到他将如何处理他所认为的国家面临的其他一些最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: We have a health crisis, an economic crisis, a racial justice crisis, a climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们面临着健康危机、经济危机、种族正义危机和气候危机。

sentences.en: So in a way, the pandemic gives shape and form and really crystallizes what a Joe Biden policy agenda and presidency would actually look like.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，疫情赋予了乔·拜登的政策议程和总统任期以形状和形式，并真正使其具体化。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's still very focused on beating President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他仍然非常专注于击败特朗普总统。

sentences.en: But it's that plus a lot more because bringing the country back together and restoring normalcy in the country has a much different meaning than it did a year ago.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是这些，因为让国家重新团结起来并恢复正常状态，其含义与一年前大不相同。

sentences.en: So how should we think about Joe Biden's post pandemic or, I guess, pandemic adjacent agenda?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该如何看待乔·拜登的后疫情时代，或者说，疫情相关的议程呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think those are good terms to sort of introduce into the way we talk about this,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这些词汇引入我们讨论的方式很好，

sentences.en: because I think you can break up his overarching agenda into a couple of different categories.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为你可以将他的总体议程分为几个不同的类别。

sentences.en: And one of them is really pandemic specific policies,
sentences.zh: 其中之一确实是疫情特定的政策，

sentences.en: things that he is going to do or try to do because the pandemic exists that he would not have tried to do and would have had no relevance to people in the absence of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 即因为疫情存在而他将要做或尝试做的事情，如果不是因为疫情，他根本不会尝试，对人们也毫无意义。

sentences.en: I think there's a second group of policies that, yeah, I think you could think of them as pandemic adjacent, that they are related to what's going on,
sentences.zh: 我认为有第二组政策，是的，你可以认为它们是与疫情相关的，它们与正在发生的事情有关，

sentences.en: ideas related to health care and economic fairness and the structure of work and workers' rights that he and his party have been pushing for a long time.
sentences.zh: 即关于医疗保健、经济公平以及工作结构和工人权利的想法，他和他的党派长期以来一直在推动这些。

sentences.en: And then I think there's a third group of policies that are not really about fixing the pandemic and don't have a natural tie in to COVID,
sentences.zh: 然后我认为有第三组政策，它们并不是真正为了解决疫情，与新冠也没有天然的联系，

sentences.en: but are big progressive goals that any Democratic president would have wanted to pursue.
sentences.zh: 但它们是任何民主党总统都会想要追求的宏大进步目标。

sentences.en: And the question for Biden is,
sentences.zh: 而对拜登来说，问题在于，

sentences.en: can he pursue them even in the presence of COVID or does he have to wait until he has mastered the pandemic in order to get to this third tranche of goals?
sentences.zh: 他能在疫情期间追求这些目标吗？还是必须等到他控制住疫情后才能实现这第三类目标？

sentences.en: So let's start with the first bucket in the Biden policy agenda, his immediate response to the pandemic and the economic crisis that flows from it.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们从拜登政策议程的第一个篮子开始，即他对疫情和由此引发的经济危机的直接反应。

sentences.en: What is the Biden pandemic plan?
sentences.zh: 拜登的疫情计划是什么？

sentences.en: So this is a suite of policies that I think people have probably been hearing a lot about recently because they are so directly tied into the conversation about economic aid that has been happening in Congress.
sentences.zh: 这是一套政策，我想人们最近可能听到了很多，因为它们与国会一直在进行的关于经济援助的讨论直接相关。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, you have a set of economic policies related to additional business aid.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你有一套与额外商业援助相关的经济政策。

sentences.en: We should be providing the money the House has passed in order to be able to go out and get people the help they need to keep their businesses open.
sentences.zh: 我们应该提供众议院通过的资金，以便能够走出去，为人们提供他们维持企业运营所需的帮助。

sentences.en: Extended crisis unemployment prograMs.
sentences.zh: 延长危机失业救济计划。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi and Schumer, they have a plan.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西和舒默，他们有一个计划。

sentences.en: He won't even meet with them.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不愿与他们会面。

sentences.en: The Republicans won't meet with the Senate.
sentences.zh: 共和党人不会在参议院与他们会面。

sentences.en: Emergency aid to state and local governments.
sentences.zh: 对州和地方政府的紧急援助。

sentences.en: As a speaker of the House and the minority leader in the Senate have proposed a significant amount of money, about $850 billion for state and local aid.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长和参议院少数党领袖已经提议了一笔可观的资金，大约8500亿美元用于州和地方援助。

sentences.en: And I think it's necessary.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是必要的。

sentences.en: We've got to get it out there now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在必须把它发下去。

sentences.en: These are issues that are being debated on Capitol Hill right now.
sentences.zh: 这些是目前国会山正在辩论的问题。

sentences.en: And, Michael, in my reporting going back to last spring, I heard from Biden advisors that he was particularly zeroed in on this issue of state and local aid,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，根据我从去年春天开始的报道，我从拜登的顾问那里听说，他特别关注州和地方援助这个问题，

sentences.en: propping up governments and making sure that you didn't end up with a situation in the winter or next spring where you would have mass layoffs of municipal employees that provide essential services.
sentences.zh: 支持政府，确保你不会在冬天或明年春天陷入大规模裁减提供基本服务的市政雇员的情况。

sentences.en: The number of firefighters you'd have to lay off, the number of teachers you'd have to lay off, the number of police officers you'd have to lay off,
sentences.zh: 你需要裁减的消防员数量、你需要裁减的教师数量、你需要裁减的警察数量，

sentences.en: the number of essential workers you'd have to lay off is staggering.
sentences.zh: 你需要裁减的基本工作人员数量是惊人的。

sentences.en: And this is exactly what the president and congressional Republicans have been quite resistant to direct federal money to states and local governments.
sentences.zh: 而这正是总统和国会共和党人一直非常抵制的，即直接向州和地方政府提供联邦资金。

sentences.en: They have actually called it a blue state bailout.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至称之为“蓝州救助”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the view from the Biden campaign and Democrats is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 拜登竞选团队和民主党人的观点是，你知道，

sentences.en: this is not just a blue state problem and that a state like Texas or Tennessee is going to have deep service cuts in the absence of some kind of federal aid as well.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一个蓝州问题，如果没有某种形式的联邦援助，像德克萨斯州或田纳西州这样的州也会出现严重的服务削减。

sentences.en: So he has said that he will do aid on a massive scale.
sentences.zh: 所以他说他将进行大规模的援助。

sentences.en: The specifics of what that will look like will certainly depend on what the country looks like in January and what, if anything,
sentences.zh: 具体情况如何，肯定取决于一月份国家的样子，以及如果有什么的话，

sentences.en: Congress does between now and then under the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府下的国会在那之前会做什么。

sentences.en: So that is Biden's financial approach to the economic crisis of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这就是拜登应对疫情经济危机的财政方针。

sentences.en: What about the medical elements of the pandemic itself?
sentences.zh: 那么疫情本身的医疗要素呢？

sentences.en: What are the policies that he plans to put in place for that?
sentences.zh: 他计划为此实施什么政策？

sentences.en: So this is, again, I think probably a pretty familiar set of ideas to most people.
sentences.zh: 所以这又是一套我想大多数人可能相当熟悉的概念。

sentences.en: The seriousness of this virus also underscores that we need regular testing with results turned around rapidly and that's available to everyone.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒的严重性也强调了我们需要定期检测，结果能迅速反馈，并且每个人都能获得检测。

sentences.en: It's testing on a massive scale.
sentences.zh: 这是大规模的检测。

sentences.en: It's shipments of PPE all over the country, not just to hospitals, but to private businesses in order to make it safer for people to go back to work.
sentences.zh: 这是向全国各地运送个人防护装备，不仅是运往医院，还要运往私营企业，以便让人们更安全地重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: Those who test positive need to participate in contact tracing.
sentences.zh: 检测呈阳性的人需要参与接触者追踪。

sentences.en: It's a national contact tracing force.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全国性的接触者追踪力量。

sentences.en: That's obviously not something that we have right now.
sentences.zh: 这显然不是我们目前拥有的东西。

sentences.en: Everyone gets free access to testing and treatment.
sentences.zh: 每个人都能免费获得检测和治疗。

sentences.en: And when it's available, a vaccine, everyone gets it.
sentences.zh: 当疫苗可用时，每个人都能接种。

sentences.en: And it is a commitment that the government is going to pick up the cost of COVID treatment for everybody.
sentences.zh: 这是一个承诺，即政府将承担每个人的新冠治疗费用。

sentences.en: But within his public health plan, there are also some components that would endure beyond the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但在他的公共卫生计划中，也有一些会持续到疫情之后的内容。

sentences.en: Today, I'm outlining the third plank of my Build Back Better program, mobilizing a 21st century care and elderly childhood education workforce.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在概述我的“重建美好未来”计划的第三个支柱，动员21世纪的护理和幼儿教育劳动力。

sentences.en: So he has proposed essentially a massive federal investment in caregiving jobs and caregiving services, creating a public health jobs core with 100,000 people,
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上提议对护理工作和护理服务进行大规模的联邦投资，建立一个拥有10万人的公共卫生就业核心，

sentences.en: a billion-dollar plan to recruit and train nurses.
sentences.zh: 一个十亿美元的招聘和培训护士的计划。

sentences.en: That is more of a program for the future that would have had relevance to the pandemic had it already existed today.
sentences.zh: 这更多是一个面向未来的计划，如果今天已经存在，它将与疫情相关。

sentences.en: So this would be the creation of an entirely new federally subsidized workforce on a pretty grand scale.
sentences.zh: 因此，这将是在相当大的规模上建立一个全新的联邦补贴劳动力队伍。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the 100,000 public health jobs, the public health core that Biden has proposed, is not even the full extent of the program that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 而且拜登提议的10万个公共卫生工作岗位，即公共卫生核心，甚至不是我们所谈论的计划的全部范围。

sentences.en: You're also talking about people who are trained to provide support to people with substance abuse probleMs.
sentences.zh: 你还在谈论那些受过培训为有药物滥用问题的人提供支持的人。

sentences.en: You're talking about more federal funding for at-home health care services and Medicaid services for the elderly and the disabled.
sentences.zh: 你还在谈论为老年人和残疾人提供更多的联邦家庭医疗服务和医疗补助服务资金。

sentences.en: So this is an even bigger program than just 100,000 health care workers, which is on its own quite a substantial program.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个比仅仅10万名医护人员更大的计划，而这本身就是一个相当实质性的计划。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what this would seem to reflect is a very different view from Joe Biden than from President Trump about the role of government, period.
sentences.zh: 这似乎反映了乔·拜登与特朗普总统在政府角色问题上截然不同的观点。

sentences.en: I mean, especially in a crisis.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特别是在危机中。

sentences.en: But just in general, it seems like you're looking at a policy plan that envisions a much greater place for the federal government.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，看起来你正在看一个设想联邦政府发挥更大作用的政策计划。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And it is starkly different from the Trump approach,
sentences.zh: 它与特朗普的方法截然不同，

sentences.en: both because it is so proactive about how it envisions mobilizing the resources of the federal government to address the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 不仅因为它在设想如何动员联邦政府资源来应对疫情方面非常主动，

sentences.en: but also because it envisions an expansion and an enduring expansion of the role of government in health care even beyond COVID.
sentences.zh: 还因为它设想了政府在医疗保健领域作用的扩大，而且是持久的扩大，甚至超越了新冠疫情。

sentences.en: And so how should we understand this plan, politically speaking?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该如何从政治角度理解这个计划？

sentences.en: It sounds, on paper, pretty liberal.
sentences.zh: 从纸面上看，它听起来相当自由派。

sentences.en: There are clearly aspects of Biden's response plan for the pandemic that are more progressive, that they are to the left of center.
sentences.zh: 拜登的疫情应对计划中显然有一些方面更具进步性，它们处于中间偏左的位置。

sentences.en: The idea of expanding the government and government spending on health care services in permanent ways goes beyond just saying,
sentences.zh: 扩大政府和政府在医疗服务上的支出以实现永久性改变的想法，不仅仅是说，

sentences.en: what is the absolute minimum that the government ought to do or the absolute minimum that the government can spend in order to blunt the worst effects of this emergency?
sentences.zh: 政府应该做的绝对最低限度是什么，或者政府为了减轻这次紧急情况的最坏影响可以花费的绝对最低限度是什么？

sentences.en: Which is, I think, a fair way to describe a mainstream conservative approach to this.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种描述主流保守派应对方式的公平方法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间让你越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what about the second category of Biden policy proposals, which you, Alex,
sentences.zh: 那么拜登的第二类政策提案呢，也就是你，亚历克斯，

sentences.en: described as longstanding Democratic goals that have a kind of new urgency or rationale because of the pandemic?
sentences.zh: 描述为长期存在的民主党目标，因为疫情而具有了一种新的紧迫性或理由？

sentences.en: What would those be?
sentences.zh: 那些会是什么？

sentences.en: So last spring, when Biden had locked up the Democratic nomination and was starting to think about his general election strategy and platform a little bit more intensively,
sentences.zh: 所以去年春天，当拜登锁定了民主党提名，并开始更深入地思考他的大选策略和纲领时，

sentences.en: I spoke to a number of his policy advisors at the time about, you know, what else have you got on these core issues that the country is now confronting?
sentences.zh: 我当时与他的几位政策顾问谈过，关于，你知道，你们在国家现在面临的这些核心问题上还有什么其他想法？

sentences.en: You know, not just COVID-specific stuff, but, you know, there was this renewed national attention to the economic vulnerability of so many people in the country,
sentences.zh: 你知道，不仅仅是新冠疫情相关的问题，还有，你知道，全国上下重新开始关注这个国家里许多人的经济脆弱性，

sentences.en: this whole notion of essential workers, people who are putting their lives on the line to do jobs that do not compensate them generously.
sentences.zh: 以及“必要工作者”这一整个概念，这些人冒着生命危险去从事那些薪酬并不丰厚的工作。

sentences.en: And so much of what I heard back from Biden's advisors at the time was, we've got plans for those people, but they look a little bit more urgent now,
sentences.zh: 当时我从拜登的顾问那里听到很多说法是，我们有针对这些人的计划，但现在看起来更紧迫了一些，

sentences.en: and we might be able to make them a little bit bigger now because of the political and social momentum around addressing these problems in the context of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 而且由于在疫情背景下解决这些问题的政治和社会势头，我们现在或许能把这些计划做得规模更大一些。

sentences.en: So I'm thinking about proposals like infrastructure spending.
sentences.zh: 所以我正在考虑像基础设施支出这样的提案。

sentences.en: We're going to invest $2 trillion in infrastructure to get to repairing our schools, our highways, our bridges, revitalizing our locks and our daMs.
sentences.zh: 我们将投资2万亿美元用于基础设施建设，以修复我们的学校、公路、桥梁，并振兴我们的船闸和大坝。

sentences.en: Like child care spending.
sentences.zh: 比如儿童保育支出。

sentences.en: Every three- and four-year-old child will get access to free, high-quality preschool, and low- and middle-income families won't spend more than 7% of their income
sentences.zh: 每一位三岁和四岁的儿童都将获得免费、高质量的学前教育，低收入和中等收入家庭的支出将不超过其收入的7%

sentences.en: on child care for children under the age of 5.
sentences.zh: 用于5岁以下儿童的保育。

sentences.en: Like new workplace protections and, you know, union protections for people who work many of these lower-wage jobs.
sentences.zh: 比如新的工作场所保护措施，还有，你知道，为许多从事这些低薪工作的人提供工会保护。

sentences.en: Raising wages to protect workers and their overtime pay.
sentences.zh: 提高工资以保护工人和他们的加班费。

sentences.en: Ensuring access to universal health care while guaranteeing that unions and union members can keep their current insurance if they choose.
sentences.zh: 确保全民医保的普及，同时保证工会和工会成员如果愿意，可以保留他们现有的保险。

sentences.en: And above all, more union members, more unions, more collective bargaining everywhere in America.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在美国各地增加工会成员，增加工会，增加集体谈判。

sentences.en: These are policies that Joe Biden and other Democrats supported before the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这些都是乔·拜登和其他民主党人在新冠疫情之前就支持的政策。

sentences.en: And they're policies that, for the most part, they've been supporting for years, if not decades.
sentences.zh: 而且这些政策在很大程度上，他们已经支持了多年，甚至几十年了。

sentences.en: And now there's a political context for those proposals that makes them maybe more sellable to voters who are not already enthusiastic about them
sentences.zh: 现在，这些提案有了政治背景，使得它们对那些本来并不热衷的选民来说可能更容易被接受，

sentences.en: and that creates a mood of urgency in Washington where lawmakers who may, under different circumstances, have felt like,
sentences.zh: 这在华盛顿营造了一种紧迫感，让那些在不同情况下可能会觉得，

sentences.en: well, I don't really need to do a big bill about union rights, might now feel a little bit differently about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的不需要制定一项关于工会权利的大型法案的立法者，现在可能会有不同的想法。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'm curious how you think that would work.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你认为这会如何运作。

sentences.en: How, for example, stronger union protections or child care programs get tethered to the pandemic
sentences.zh: 例如，更强有力的工会保护或儿童保育计划是如何与疫情挂钩的，

sentences.en: in a way that makes it possible for a Biden-Harris presidency and vice presidency to push them through.
sentences.zh: 从而使拜登-哈里斯的总统和副总统任期能够推动它们通过。

sentences.en: So we have seen in our polling and in polling from other media entities that the idea of ramping up federal spending on workers and on infrastructure and on child care,
sentences.zh: 我们在我们的民调以及其他媒体机构的民调中看到，增加联邦在工人、基础设施和儿童保育方面的支出这一想法，

sentences.en: this is all very popular.
sentences.zh: 是非常受欢迎的。

sentences.en: And because these are problems that are front and center in the campaign and in all likelihood for the next administration, whoever is running it,
sentences.zh: 而且因为这些问题是竞选活动中的核心问题，而且极有可能也是下一届政府（无论谁在执政）的核心问题，

sentences.en: there is a level of focus on these issues that there usually, frankly, is not.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，人们对这些问题的关注程度通常是前所未有的。

sentences.en: And when you say more focus, I'm guessing, for example, there are tens of millions of Americans who suddenly are dealing with child care in a very new way
sentences.zh: 当你提到更多关注时，我猜，例如，有数千万美国人突然以一种全新的方式处理儿童保育问题，

sentences.en: because they are working from home and their kids can't go to school.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在家工作，而他们的孩子不能去上学。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And, you know, any new administration faces a question of sequencing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，任何新政府都面临着先后顺序的问题。

sentences.en: What are you going to do and when are you going to do it?
sentences.zh: 你要做什么，什么时候做？

sentences.en: And an incoming Biden administration, I think it's pretty clear that issues like infrastructure spending, child care, union rights, health care, this is the big stuff right now.
sentences.zh: 对于即将上任的拜登政府，我认为很清楚的是，基础设施支出、儿童保育、工会权利、医疗保健，这些是目前的大事。

sentences.en: I think they're very sensitive to the reality that if Biden is not perceived as a success on getting the country healthy and working again,
sentences.zh: 我认为他们非常清楚这样一个现实：如果拜登在让国家恢复健康和重新工作方面不被视为成功，

sentences.en: then very little else that he does is likely to matter for him politically.
sentences.zh: 那么他在政治上做的其他事情可能都无关紧要了。

sentences.en: But that's going to be the big teSt.
sentences.zh: 但这将是最大的考验。

sentences.en: I think the issue of climate change is an emblematic one for this category, maybe the most important one,
sentences.zh: 我认为气候变化问题是这一类别中的一个标志性问题，也许是最重要的一个，

sentences.en: where the Democratic administration would always have wanted to do a big climate bill.
sentences.zh: 民主党政府一直都想制定一项大型气候法案。

sentences.en: But a big, expensive infrastructure bill that includes trillions of dollars on spending on renewable energy and putting people to work in energy fields
sentences.zh: 但是一项大型、昂贵的基础设施法案，包括数万亿美元的可再生能源支出，并让人们在能源领域就业，

sentences.en: is a more direct response of the employment crisis we are facing now than it might have been in the economic conditions of a year ago.
sentences.zh: 比一年前的经济条件下，更能直接应对我们现在面临的就业危机。

sentences.en: I think that the gigantic asterisk over all of this is that we don't know exactly what the balance of power is going to be in Congress.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一切之上有一个巨大的星号，那就是我们不知道国会的权力平衡究竟会是什么样。

sentences.en: Some of the stuff that we're talking about is going to have an easier time getting passed than others.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的一些事情比其他事情更容易通过。

sentences.en: Infrastructure is very broadly popular.
sentences.zh: 基础设施建设非常广泛地受到欢迎。

sentences.en: There's certainly Republican votes out there for infrastructure legislation.
sentences.zh: 当然有共和党人投票支持基础设施立法。

sentences.en: But if the Senate's 50-50 or if it's a Republican Senate, then President Biden might well be able to get through a whole bunch of emergency economic spending
sentences.zh: 但如果参议院是50对50，或者如果是一个共和党控制的参议院，那么拜登总统可能确实能够通过一大堆紧急经济支出

sentences.en: and health care spending.
sentences.zh: 和医疗保健支出。

sentences.en: And then when you get to the issue of union rights or of creating a public option for health insurance, then he might just hit a wall where 50 Republican senators
sentences.zh: 然后当你谈到工会权利或为医疗保险创建公共选项的问题时，他可能会撞上一堵墙，50名共和党参议员

sentences.en: or 48 Republican senators and a couple of Democrats say, you know what, that's a bridge too far for me.
sentences.zh: 或者48名共和党参议员和几名民主党人会说，你知道吗，这对我来说太过分了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I could see the Republicans' argument very clearly in advance, and it would be a crisis.
sentences.zh: 我可以很清楚地预见到共和党的论点，那将是一场危机。

sentences.en: An economic crisis and a medical crisis is no time to push through your liberal vision of, you know, XYZ, labor, child care, infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 经济危机和医疗危机不是推行你们自由派愿景（你知道的，XYZ，劳工、儿童保育、基础设施）的时候。

sentences.en: This is a time for nonpartisan problem solving.
sentences.zh: 现在是进行无党派问题解决的时候。

sentences.en: And therefore, their argument would be, we see through this.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们的论点会是，我们看穿了这一点。

sentences.en: You are just shoehorning liberal policies into a crisis.
sentences.zh: 你们只是把自由派政策强加到危机中。

sentences.en: You know, I think this is another place where when you talk to people who know Joe Biden well,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是另一个方面，当你和那些非常了解乔·拜登的人交谈时，

sentences.en: the experience of the Obama administration certainly informs the political thinking around this too, that, you know, he is hugely proud of the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府的经历当然也影响了围绕这一点的政治思考，你知道，他为《平价医疗法案》感到无比自豪。

sentences.en: I think that he and others around him are keenly aware of the political pain that ensued when the country believed that the Obama administration had moved on
sentences.zh: 我认为他和周围的人敏锐地意识到，当国家认为奥巴马政府已经从处理2008年经济危机转向处理医疗保健问题时所产生的政治痛苦，

sentences.en: from dealing with the economic crisis of 2008 to deal with health care, which voters didn't necessarily see as directly connected to an employment and financial crisis
sentences.zh: 选民们并不一定认为这与他们自己生活中正在发生的就业和金融危机直接相关。

sentences.en: that was happening in their own lives.
sentences.zh: 那正在发生。

sentences.en: I think it's pretty widely accepted in the Democratic Party that had the Obama administration put as much effort into communicating with the country
sentences.zh: 我认为在民主党内有一个广泛的共识，如果奥巴马政府在与全国沟通方面投入了同样多的努力，

sentences.en: around the nature and values of their economic recovery plans as they did on health care reform, that maybe the 2010 midterm elections would not have been such a devastating defeat
sentences.zh: 围绕其经济复苏计划的性质和价值观，就像他们在医疗改革上所做的那样，也许2010年的中期选举就不会是民主党如此惨痛的失败了。

sentences.en: for the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党来说。

sentences.en: And so that's going to be, I think, the sort of stress point on this second category of Joe Biden policy goals.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这将是乔·拜登政策目标第二类中的压力点。

sentences.en: How much of this does the public see as an important response to this crisis or as a really good idea,
sentences.zh: 公众在多大程度上将其视为对这场危机的重要回应，或者是一个非常好的主意，

sentences.en: the virtues of which have been exposed by this crisis?
sentences.zh: 其优点已被这场危机所揭示？

sentences.en: And what is the point where they start to say, you know, this doesn't really seem all that relevant to what's going on in my own life right now?
sentences.zh: 那么他们开始说“你知道，这对我自己现在的生活似乎并不那么相关”的临界点在哪里？

sentences.en: You're saying the lesson of 2008 and Obama and Biden was that they hadn't, in many voters' minds, fully confronted the fallout of the 2008 economic crisis
sentences.zh: 你是说2008年奥巴马和拜登的教训是，在许多选民看来，他们并没有完全面对2008年经济危机的后果，

sentences.en: when they moved on to something that perhaps they said was a response to that, a massive health care reform, but in many voters' minds was unrelated.
sentences.zh: 当他们转向也许他们说是对那场危机的回应——大规模医疗改革时，但在许多选民看来，这与危机无关。

sentences.en: So the lesson for them is stay focused on the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的教训是专注于疫情。

sentences.en: And if you're going to do anything beyond solving for the pandemic and the economic crisis, then make sure it is clearly connected in people's minds to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 如果你要在解决疫情和经济危机之外做任何事情，那么请确保它在人们心目中与疫情有明确的联系。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's frankly what we have seen Biden doing for most of the general election.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，这就是我们在大选期间看到拜登所做的事情。

sentences.en: Those who have complications from COVID-19 could become the new pre-existing conditions.
sentences.zh: 那些有新冠肺炎并发症的人可能会成为新的“既往症”。

sentences.en: That when he talks about his plans for health care.
sentences.zh: 当他谈论他的医疗保健计划时。

sentences.en: We need a public option now more than ever, especially when more than 20 million people are unemployed.
sentences.zh: 我们现在比以往任何时候都更需要公共选项，特别是在超过2000万人失业的情况下。

sentences.en: Or for child care.
sentences.zh: 或者对于儿童保育。

sentences.en: You know, we're trapped in a caregiving crisis, within an economic crisis, within a health care crisis.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们被困在了一场护理危机中，处于经济危机之中，处于医疗保健危机之中。

sentences.en: Or for climate.
sentences.zh: 或者对于气候。

sentences.en: When I think about climate change, the word I think of is jobs.
sentences.zh: 当我想到气候变化时，我想到的词是工作。

sentences.en: Good pain.
sentences.zh: 好的报酬。

sentences.en: Union jobs.
sentences.zh: 工会工作。

sentences.en: That have put Americans to work.
sentences.zh: 让美国人有工作可做。

sentences.en: He is framing it as a response to the crisis, even if some of those plans predated the crisis.
sentences.zh: 他将其定性为对危机的回应，即使其中一些计划早于这场危机。

sentences.en: Okay, I think that brings us to the third and final category in your telling, which is policies that are kind of on the back burner because of the pandemic
sentences.zh: 好的，我认为这把我们带到了你所说的第三类也是最后一类，即因为疫情而被搁置的政策，

sentences.en: that might require ending the pandemic to accomplish.
sentences.zh: 可能需要结束疫情才能实现。

sentences.en: Which of these stand out to you?
sentences.zh: 其中哪些对你来说很突出？

sentences.en: These are cornerstone progressive policy goals where you have enormous momentum on the Democratic
sentences.zh: 这些是进步派政策的基石目标，你在民主党方面有巨大的势头去采取行动，

sentences.en: side for acting, but where there's not an obvious or unmissable tie into the pandemic and the economic recession.
sentences.zh: 但它们与疫情和经济衰退之间没有明显或不可错过的联系。

sentences.en: Take immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 以移民改革为例。

sentences.en: Take gun control.
sentences.zh: 以枪支管制为例。

sentences.en: These are policies that are, of course, enormously salient to the country's experience the last four years.
sentences.zh: 这些政策当然与过去四年国家的经历息息相关。

sentences.en: And where there's no question a Biden administration or any Democratic administration would take some action at the executive level
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，拜登政府或任何民主党政府都会在行政层面采取一些行动，

sentences.en: to undo President Trump's approach, certainly to an issue like immigration.
sentences.zh: 来推翻特朗普总统的做法，当然是在移民这样的问题上。

sentences.en: But are you going to get a big, complicated immigration reform bill through the House and Senate in the first couple months of your term when the country looks like it does today?
sentences.zh: 但是，当国家看起来像今天这样时，你能在任期的头几个月里让一项复杂的大型移民改革法案在众议院和参议院通过吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to be able to dedicate the political capital you would need to pass major gun control legislation through a Senate where Democrats are not likely to have a big majority if they have a majority when you're trying to bring the country out of a recession?
sentences.zh: 当你试图带领国家走出衰退时，你能在民主党不太可能拥有多数席位（如果他们有多数席位的话）的参议院里，投入通过重大枪支管制立法所需的政治资本吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm asking.
sentences.zh: 我是在问。

sentences.en: That's not sort of a rhetorical question intended to imply that, of course, that won't happen.
sentences.zh: 这并不是一个旨在暗示“当然不会发生”的反问。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it's clearly going to be a heavier lift for a Democratic president next year than passing infrastructure spending and hiring tens of thousands of health care workers.
sentences.zh: 但显然，对于明年的民主党总统来说，这比通过基础设施支出和雇佣数万名医护人员要困难得多。

sentences.en: The exception in this category might be police reform.
sentences.zh: 这一类别的例外可能是警察改革。

sentences.en: It is an issue that has defined the general election in a way that, frankly, you know,
sentences.zh: 这是一个以某种方式定义了大选的问题，坦率地说，你知道，

sentences.en: an issue like gun control just hasn't and where there is some bipartisan appetite in Washington for getting something done.
sentences.zh: 像枪支管制这样的问题并没有，而且在华盛顿，两党对于完成一些事情是有一些意愿的。

sentences.en: So it is, for me anyway, and I think for Democrats I talk to, easier to imagine legislation passing early next year that, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，对我来说，我想对于我交谈过的民主党人来说，更容易想象明年年初通过的立法，你知道，

sentences.en: bans police chokeholds and establishes federal use of force guidelines than some of the other big ticket items that we're talking about here.
sentences.zh: 禁止警察锁喉并建立联邦武力使用准则，要比我们在这里谈论的其他一些大项目更容易。

sentences.en: Certainly, it's very, very hard to imagine a scenario where Joe Biden walks away from police reform after the way he has talked about it in this campaign.
sentences.zh: 当然，很难想象乔·拜登在竞选中谈论警察改革之后会放弃它的情景。

sentences.en: Alex, when you think about all these policies and just how tied they all are ultimately to the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，当你想到所有这些政策，以及它们最终与疫情的联系时，

sentences.en: how much do you think that all of this is the set of policies that Joe Biden wanted for his potential presidency?
sentences.zh: 你认为所有这些在多大程度上是乔·拜登为他潜在的总统任期所想要的一套政策？

sentences.en: I mean, is this an agenda that he has been kind of forced into based on the moment?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个他基于当下时刻被迫接受的议程吗？

sentences.en: And if this were not the moment, we would be having a very, very different conversation about the kinds of policies that Joe Biden stood for.
sentences.zh: 如果不是现在这个时刻，我们将会对乔·拜登所代表的政策类型进行非常、非常不同的对话。

sentences.en: You know, in the absence of the pandemic, I think we'd be talking about a lot of the same issues,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在没有疫情的情况下，我认为我们会谈论很多同样的问题，

sentences.en: but we'd probably be talking about a different balance of issues and a different overall focus for a Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 但我们可能会谈论不同问题的平衡，以及拜登政府不同的整体重点。

sentences.en: Perhaps the Joe Biden of a year and a half ago might have imagined that he would get into office and his role would be to restore dignity to the presidency,
sentences.zh: 也许一年半前的乔·拜登可能想象过他会进入办公室，他的角色将是恢复总统职位的尊严，

sentences.en: spend a lot of time overseas rebuilding the role of the United States in the world and restoring American alliances,
sentences.zh: 花大量时间在海外重建美国在世界上的角色并恢复美国联盟，

sentences.en: trying to foster a level of bipartisanship in Washington that obviously has not existed there in a long time.
sentences.zh: 试图在华盛顿培养一种显然在很长一段时间内都不存在的两党合作水平。

sentences.en: And then pursuing versions of a lot of the stuff that we've talked about.
sentences.zh: 然后追求我们谈论过的很多东西的版本。

sentences.en: He was always going to try to do a climate bill if he became president.
sentences.zh: 如果他成为总统，他总是会尝试制定一项气候法案。

sentences.en: He's always promised to try to do a public health insurance option if he's elected president, an infrastructure bill.
sentences.zh: 他总是承诺如果当选总统，会尝试制定一项公共医疗保险选项，一项基础设施法案。

sentences.en: But I think the scale and intensity of the focus on the economy, the health care system, the environment is going to be on a different order of magnitude because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，由于疫情，对经济、医疗体系、环境的关注规模和强度将达到不同的数量级。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, that is consistent with what we have seen throughout American history, that moments of economic emergency do lend themselves to bigger,
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，这与我们在整个美国历史上所看到的一致，即经济紧急时刻确实有助于更大规模、

sentences.en: more activist government of the kind that even a moderate Democrat like Joe Biden has pretty consistently support in his career.
sentences.zh: 更积极的政府，即使是像乔·拜登这样的温和派民主党人在他的职业生涯中也相当一致地支持这种政府。

sentences.en: Well, Alex, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，亚历克斯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the number of new coronavirus infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，美国的新冠病毒感染人数

sentences.en: is climbing toward a third peak, similar to spikes in April and July.
sentences.zh: 正在攀升至第三个高峰，类似于4月和7月的激增。

sentences.en: Epidemiologists are warning of a frightening new phase of the pandemic, in which cases are surging across at least 41 states.
sentences.zh: 流行病学家警告说，疫情进入了一个令人恐惧的新阶段，病例在至少41个州激增。

sentences.en: In fact, no state in the country is currently experiencing a sustained decline in infections.
sentences.zh: 事实上，全国目前没有任何一个州经历感染人数的持续下降。

sentences.en: Public health officials are blaming the spikes on pandemic fatigue as Americans grow weary of restrictions on their lives nearly eight months into the virus.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生官员将激增归咎于疫情疲劳，因为美国人在病毒爆发近八个月后，对生活限制感到厌倦。

sentences.en: And if a vaccine were approved by between now and the end of the year, would you take it?
sentences.zh: 如果从现在到年底之间批准了一种疫苗，你会接种吗？

sentences.en: And if you were to become president, would you mandate that everyone has to take it?
sentences.zh: 如果你成为总统，你会强制要求每个人都接种吗？

sentences.en: During simultaneous town halls on Thursday night, held in lieu of the second presidential debate, Joe Biden said he would take the coronavirus vaccine.
sentences.zh: 在周四晚上的同步市政厅会议期间（代替了第二场总统辩论），乔·拜登表示他会接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: Yes, I would take it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会接种。

sentences.en: I'd encourage people to take it.
sentences.zh: 我会鼓励人们接种。

sentences.en: If it went through the traditional testing process and was endorsed by scientists.
sentences.zh: 如果它经过了传统的测试过程并得到了科学家的认可。

sentences.en: On behalf of voters, who do you owe $421 million to?
sentences.zh: 代表选民，你欠谁4.21亿美元？

sentences.en: What they did is illegal, number one.
sentences.zh: 他们所做的是非法的，第一点。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, after repeated denials, President Trump, for the first time, seemed to confirm Times reporting that he owes more than $400 million in debt.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在多次否认之后，特朗普总统首次似乎证实了《泰晤士报》关于他背负超过4亿美元债务的报道。

sentences.en: $400 million isn't that much?
sentences.zh: 4亿美元不是很多吗？

sentences.en: I guess office buildings.
sentences.zh: 我想是办公楼。

sentences.en: But are you confirming that, yes, you do owe some $400 million?
sentences.zh: 但你是在证实，是的，你确实欠了大约4亿美元吗？

sentences.en: What I'm saying is that it's a tiny percentage of my net worth.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，这只是我净资产的一小部分。

sentences.en: That sounds like yes.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是肯定的回答。

sentences.en: And you'll see that soon because we're doing things, you know.
sentences.zh: 你很快就会看到，因为我们正在做一些事情，你知道。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我将与Sarah Koenig一起，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
